title: SprintWorksheetRow
description: A single row in the 3APK Planning Worksheet Notion database, linking a DoR-passed backlog item to a sprint with team-adjusted estimates. Mirrors the Go SprintWorksheetRow struct and drives the canonical CSV export columns.

story_id.description: Foreign key to the BacklogItem.id this row references.

sprint_id.description: Foreign key to the Sprint this item is committed to.

title.description: Denormalised story title for worksheet readability.

user_story.description: Denormalised user story text for quick reference during planning.

acceptance_criteria.description: Denormalised acceptance criteria, joined from the array for CSV compatibility.

ai_estimate_hours.description: AI-suggested estimate range midpoint in hours. Nullable when the skill has not produced an estimate.

final_estimate_hours.description: Team-adjusted final estimate in hours after human review. Required for sprint commitment.

final_estimate_points.description: Team-adjusted final estimate in story points. Nullable when team uses hours only.

human_adjustment_log.description: Mandatory log of why the team adjusted the AI estimate. Records rationale for PEX evidence and estimate accuracy tracking.

assigned_to.description: Team member assigned to the story for the sprint.

dor_passed.description: Denormalised DoR pass status from the linked BacklogItem. Worksheet view filters on this = true.
